shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|specs/.+#' src/config.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg --files src | rg -i 'provider|promptBuilder'; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts; cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.test.ts | head -80; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src | head; ls scripts/spec-links; cat scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"describe('beforeSession failure'\", \"// specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#7\\ndescribe('beforeSession failure'\")

p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- "'`beforeSession` is awaited before the `try` block opens'"', '- Target for HALEngine#94: when "'`beforeSession` throws an `Error`, the caller receives the same error, `onError` receives the session and error, and `afterSession` runs before any user-input processing ([validated by: reports and cleans up a failed beforeSession while preserving the rejection](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts#L8)).'"\\n- "'`beforeSession` is awaited before the `try` block opens'"')

npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m 'Add acceptance test for session setup failures' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status"
